ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution with a ratio of approximately 1.2:1 (low-intensity black to high-intensity white) across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black region centered on the peduncle-notch axis (central 40% of span); white pigmentation occupies the lateral lobes with significant black stippling at the distal 15% of each lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle of approximately 45 degrees with vertex depth approximately 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge; frequency increases towards the distal tips with pixel peaks every 10-15 pixels of linear width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature from the notch to the tips, tapering to acute, slightly upturned distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clustered dark circular stippling on the white lateral fields, most dense on the far right and far left distal regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four parallel dark linear streaks (rake marks) originating from the trailing edge and extending mid-lobe on the right side; faint vertical linear marks present near the left side of the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent rake marks on the right lobe; significant jaggedness and irregular tissue loss at both distal tips (notches/amputations).
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct dark focal spot in the lower-central quadrant of the left lobe's primary white field.
